steps.objective: Run main.py against all three provided sample inputs and verify expected outputs.
success_evidence: Each executed command's stdout matches the corresponding expected sample output after trailing whitespace removal

steps.objective: Run a maximal-size stress test and measure time/memory.

constraints: Use a valid input with W,H up to 1e6 and N up to 30

patch.reason: Plan to implement main.py, then run provided samples, brute-force self-checks, and a stress test to satisfy the delivered code and verification requirements.

goal_obligations.predicate: main.py exists in the project root and contains a Python 3 standard-library program that reads exactly one test case from stdin (W H N and device coordinates as specified) and prints the maximum number of collected nuggets as a single integer followed by a newline to stdout, for all valid inputs within constraints.
The program outputs 19, 9, and 112 respectively for the three provided sample inputs when executed in separate fresh processes, ignoring trailing whitespace.
The program passes a self-created correctness check that compares its output to an independent brute-force solver on multiple small random valid inputs (W,H,N <= 8), with no mismatches.
The program completes a maximal-size valid stress input (e.g., W=H=1e6, N=30) within 3 seconds wall time and 512 MiB address space.
